title: Need game ideas
author: Useful_Use_6170
selftext:
Want to create a bacteria style game, similar to agrario but their would be different types of bacteria   
Dmg  
Defense  
Speed  
Absorb %  
Hp

Also depending on what you absorb you will evolve to a hybrid version of that bacteria 

But wondering if progression should roguelike, per run , or you keep all your stats ? Or add a passive talent tree 

Any ideas ?

comments.author: Blake9712
comments.body: I thought about trying to make a small scale but somewhat realistic plague like simulator, where you essentially have little towns of npcs with shops and work places that go on about there daily loop in at least 3 towns for the simulation, and if one gets sick depending on the disease it can spread to other actual npcs instead of just map tiles and you can then sort of track and watch how the disease transports person to person. But my idea was more about what simulated actions would stop x disease,  ie maybe a dark mode where you just make the policies without technically knowing what the disease was,  I wanted something from a disease prevention standpoint. I’m not doing it tho cause my actual game eats all my tokens and time
